name: The Doom Brutalist Community Project
summary:
Rejoice! Lovers of All Things Grey!

Welcome to D.B.C.P. or the Doom Brutalist Community Project, inspired by Quake community's Quake Brutalist Jam, it is an community project where we seek to bring brutalism to the colourful world of good o' Doom. Venture through twenty-eight maps of different mapper's interpretation of brutalism and their implementation in Doom, whether it is a grey desolate mega structure, an aftermath of socialist brutalism, or an abandoned cement city which had become mother-nature's lush garden.
